description_en: Associates a prefix list with an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
description_zh: 为企业版转发路由器路由表绑定前缀列表
kebab_example: aliyun cbn create-transit-router-prefix-list-association --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --transit-router-id tr-6ehx7q2jze8ch5ji00000 --prefix-list-id pl-6ehtn5kqxgeyy08fi0000 --transit-router-table-id vtb-6ehgc262hr170qgyc0000 --next-hop tr-attach-flbq507rg2ckrj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the transit router instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transit router instance
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en:
The next hop type. Valid values:

BlackHole: All CIDR blocks in the prefix list are blackhole routes. All traffic destined for the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is dropped.
VPC: The next hop of the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) connection.
VBR: The next hop of the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is a Virtual Border Router (VBR) connection.
TR: The next hop of the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is an inter-region connection.
ECR: The next hop of the CIDR blocks in the prefix list is an Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
parameters.help_zh:
下一跳类型。取值：

BlackHole：表示指定前缀列表下的网段均为黑洞路由，所有去往前缀列表下网段的流量均会被丢弃。
VPC：表示指定前缀列表下网段的下一跳为专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接。
VBR：表示指定前缀列表下网段的下一跳为边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）连接。
TR：表示指定前缀列表下网段的下一跳为跨地域连接。
ECR：表示指定前缀列表下网段的下一跳为专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）实例
parameters.name: next_hop_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the prefix list
parameters.name: prefix_list_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transit router route table
parameters.name: transit_router_table_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the next hop connection.

To configure all CIDR blocks in the prefix list as blackhole routes, set this parameter to BlackHole
parameters.help_zh:
下一跳连接ID。

如果要使前缀列表下的网段均为黑洞路由，本参数需输入BlackHole
parameters.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the prefix list
parameters.help_zh: 前缀列表所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: owner_uid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without creating the association. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and creates the association after the check is passed.

This parameter is currently not available
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建绑定关系。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建绑定关系。

本参数当前不生效
parameters.name: dry_run
